chunks: And by his chain, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Ubayd ibn Zurara and Fazl Abu al-Abbas, who said:

We said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'What do you say regarding a man who marries a woman, then dies while she is still his wife, and he has obligated the dower for her?' He said: 'For her is half the dower, and she inherits him from everything, and if she had died, so it would be like that.'
ai.seo_question: What is the dower and inheritance share for a wife widowed before marital relations?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the dual entitlement of a widow who was widowed before consummation: she receives half of the stipulated dower while simultaneously inheriting a full share of her husband's estate, a ruling that underscores the distinct legal status of the 'documented but unconsummated' marriage in Shia jurisprudence. The narration highlights the symmetry of the ruling, noting that the wife's share remains unchanged regardless of whether she predeceases her husband or he predeceases her, reflecting the principle of equity in marital financial obligations.

en.hubeali: And by his chain, from Aban Bin Usman, from Ubeyd Bin Zurara, and Fazl Abu Al Abbas both said,

‘We said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘What are you<sup>asws</sup> saying regarding a man who marries a woman, then dies from her, and the dower was obligated for her?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For her is half the dower, and she would inherit him from everything, and if she had died, so it would be like that’.
en.sarwar: 7. Through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith the following is narrated from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from ‘Ubayd ibn Zurarah and Fadl ibn al-‘Abbas who have said the following:

“Once we asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who marries a woman and then dies. He has set mahr (dower) for her. He (the Imam) said, ’She deserve one-half of the mahr (dower) and complete inheritance. If she dies the same rule applies in her favor.’”
